entries.wording: （个人物品）广州白云机场已送仓库
entries.english: (Personal goods) taken to the warehouse at Guangzhou Baiyun airport
entries.note: The firm's first row: the parcel has landed and reached its clearance warehouse.

entries.english: (Personal goods) taken to customs at Guangzhou Baiyun airport, queuing for clearance

entries.wording: （个人物品）广州白云机场已清关
entries.english: (Personal goods) cleared at Guangzhou Baiyun airport
entries.note: Import clearance done: the parcel goes on.

entries.wording: （个人物品）广州白云机场清关完毕，货物进入国内快递，荣通公司尽快将货物送到客户手上
entries.english: (Personal goods) clearance at Guangzhou Baiyun airport finished, the goods enter domestic express, Rongtong will bring them to the customer as soon as it can
entries.note: The firm's last row: handed on for delivery in China.
